bi.story.1.text: Every evening, Balance Scale Island opens its night market by the harbour.

bi.story.2.text: Bobbo runs the weighing stall. Tonight, the rain washed every label off his bags!

bi.story.3.text: The bags are sealed, so nobody can peek inside. Customers are waiting.

bi.story.4.text: I'm Rumble. A level scale never lies. Let's find each weight, one fair step at a time.

bi.story.mid1.text: The queue is shrinking. Labels are going back on!

bi.story.mid2.text: Halfway there. The harbour lanterns are lighting up.

bi.story.mid3.text: Last few bags before the market closes.

bi.story.end1.text: Every bag has its label back, and the night market is buzzing.

bi.story.end2.text: You kept both sides equal every single time. That's how equations work.

bi.story.end3.text: You earned the Balance Keeper badge. Tomorrow, the bags get trickier!

bi.prompt.tutorial.text: Take the same weight off both pans until the bag is on its own.

bi.prompt.one.text: Keep the scale balanced. What does one bag weigh?

bi.prompt.both.text: Bags on both pans! What does one bag weigh?

bi.prompt.story.text: Read the story. Which equation matches it? Then solve it.

bi.story.matched.text: That equation matches the story. Now solve it on the scale.

bi.story.retry.text: Not quite. Check where each number in the story belongs.

bi.help.explain.text: A balanced scale is an equation. Whatever you do to one pan, do to the other.

bi.help.hint.text: Test it. Put that weight in every bag. Does the scale stay level? Try taking the same off both pans.

bi.tilt.text: It tipped! Do the same to the other pan to level it.

bi.level.text: Level again. Look at the new equation.

bi.alone.text: One bag on its own! Now you can read what it weighs.

bi.idle.text: Drag a weight off a pan, or use the buttons to change both sides at once.

bi.retry.text: Not that one. Keep the scale level and try again.

bi.praise.1.text: One bag weighs {n}. You kept both sides balanced!

bi.praise.2.text: Yes, x is {n}. You undid each step carefully.

bi.praise.3.text: {n} it is! Same on both sides, every time.

bi.praise.4.text: Spot on. x equals {n}, and the scale stays level.

bi.hint.model.text: Let's solve it together, doing the same to both pans each step.

bi.hint.modelTap.text: One bag balances {n}. So x is {n}.
